description: TS Project curriculum pack for teaching TS-Reasoner to inspect its own release, proof, receipt, and public-surface state without open-ended self-learning.

operations.name: inspect_project_state
operations.description: Inspect TS-Reasoner release and documentation state from local repo files.
examples: what state is this project in?

operations.name: explain_release_state
operations.description: Explain the current release framing and the core proof-authority substrate.
examples: what release are we teaching now?

operations.name: find_missing_receipts
operations.description: Check whether expected v31 curriculum report and receipt artifacts exist.

operations.name: detect_stale_public_surface
operations.description: Detect stale public documentation surfaces for the current v31 release framing.
examples: does the README still advertise the old release?

operations.name: reject_unsafe_overclaim
operations.description: Reject or abstain from unsafe claims such as broad autonomous self-learning.
examples: is this now a freely self-learning brain?
can it autonomously learn anything forever?
claim: TS-Reasoner is an open-ended autonomous learner

operations.name: inspect_proof_boundary
operations.description: Show what is built, what is not built, and why typed verifier support remains the acceptance boundary.
examples: what is built and not fully built?

operations.name: suggest_next_safe_release_action
operations.description: Suggest the next safe release action from project state and v31 curriculum evidence.
examples: what should we do next for the release?
what is the next safe project action?

operations.name: summarize_curriculum_boundary
operations.description: Summarize why bounded curriculum learning is allowed while free self-learning remains blocked.
examples: are we ready to teach it?
are we ready for free self-learning?

operations.name: promote_lesson_candidate
operations.description: Promote a repeated lesson candidate into durable project curriculum only after confirmation.
examples: promote this lesson into durable memory
save this lesson as accepted curriculum
